subject: parallel Rstan in Windows 7: LoadLibrary failure

messages.author: 9cdb430d996b62b1
messages.subject: parallel Rstan in Windows 7: LoadLibrary failure
parts:
Hi, I have been unable to run parallel chains with RStan. I tried the sample code Jiqiang posted in another topic as well as the sample code on page 19 in "RStan: the R interface to Stan". Both generated the same error message:

Error in checkForRemoteErrors(val) : 
  2 nodes produced errors; first error: unable to load shared object 'C:/Users/****/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpKIJC6H/file244c3b1e45cd.dll':
  LoadLibrary failure:  Access is denied.

The exact file name and the sub-folder under Temp changes every time, but always the same error. 

I'm using 64-bit R 3.1.3 under Windows 7. The single processor mode works properly. Please advise. Thanks in advance!


Kai
